# v0.4.18: FULL gate run for the OIN_ETA_COVALENT_TARGET + OIN_VDW_EXEMPT_BINDING promotion

#       LEVER        lever-off reproduces the old row, shipped does not -> the exact fold moved it
#       STALE        lever-off does NOT reproduce the old row and equals shipped -> the row was
#                    wrong BEFORE v0.4.17. Every stale field 2 was last reproduced by the v0.4.8

#                    it went stale in v0.4.9-v0.4.14, whose re-freezes re-ran only the rows a sweep
#                    predicted. ARM 2 is run in full only at a release, so nothing said so.
#                    CAUSE, by intervention (tools/v0417/arm2_stale_cause.py, one lever off at a
#                    time): OIN_CANONICAL_DONOR_FOLD=0 ALONE restores 14 of 14 stale field-2
#                    molecules -> stale since the v0.4.13 promotion, not v0.4.14's. KIHHUG (field 3)
